COAG

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows hypoxemia, mild anemia, leukopenia with neutropenia and lymphopenia, thrombocytopenia, elevated RDW, monocytosis, basophilia, and mildly increased CRP and ferritin, suggesting inflammation or possible infection. Liver and kidney function, electrolytes, and coagulation are within normal limits. Findings may indicate acute or chronic inflammatory or infectious process, possibly with bone marrow involvement. Clinical correlation and further evaluation are recommended.
